nodes.label: Platform taxonomy stays authoritative + propose-category escape hatch (GMC two-layer)
nodes.rationale: Google Merchant Center two-layer model: a fixed platform taxonomy (google_product_category) for channel compatibility plus the seller's own free product_type. Decision: the platform taxonomy remains authoritative — the buyer needs it for navigation and facets and it feeds ТН ВЭД matching, which per-seller trees would destroy. Minimal GMC-faithful addition: a 'Предложить категорию' button creating an operator request, and an honest page caption instead of promising 'management'. A full seller tree with mandatory mapping is the audit's 'maximum' and out of this wave.

nodes.label: No autopublish: completeness computes, a human releases (Akeneo)
nodes.rationale: Akeneo: completeness is an automatic threshold blocking export until 100%, but the release decision is a HUMAN's (Collaboration Workflows end in Review; Akeneo even deprecated Published Products). Shopify likewise: Active/Draft is set by the seller. Decision: do NOT autopublish — the threshold computes itself and names what is missing, the final click stays with a person. This is exactly what already existed, so the correct answer was 'change nothing', recorded so the question does not reopen.

nodes.label: Catalog filling open pre-KYC, publication gated (Amazon Seller Central)
nodes.rationale: Amazon pattern: during account verification the seller keeps cabinet access and works on listings; they go live only after verification — suspension blocks SELLING and visibility, not the work. We had it backwards: requires:{kyc:true} hid the whole 'Номенклатура' section (a single frontend line; the backend never checked KYC for catalog at all), idling a new seller exactly when ready to work. Decision: the gate MOVED from the section to the action — catalog/publishing.py returns SELLER_KYC_REQUIRED and the UI names the reason up front (useCatalogPublishGate, same pattern as useQuoteSendGate). Strictly more rights; nothing working was taken away.

nodes.label: AI batch budget: reuse existing daily cap, show remaining, no new gate
nodes.rationale: Shopify Magic and Akeneo AI never show a cost-confirmation dialog per action — cost is governed by the plan. Our mechanism already exists: AI_DAILY_JOB_CAP_PER_COMPANY with per-tier ceilings (BASIC 75, STANDARD 300, PREMIUM unlimited), consume_credit on paid calls, and a hard batch limit (100 cards per hs-classify call). Decision: introduce NO new gate (PRODUCT RULE 2 — blocks only on explicit owner request); batch enrichment reuses the daily ceiling and batch limit; the only addition is SHOWING the remaining daily quota next to the button — information that removes surprise, not a step.
